req.title: Return PUT request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PUT /put with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /put returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a JSON body payload, (2) verify form-encoded data is reflected, (3) verify query-string args are reflected, (4) verify the negative path when using a disallowed method (GET on /put), (5) verify boundary behavior with an empty body, and (6) verify the JSON key set is exact. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put endpoint is registered
actions: Send PUT /put with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body containing field 'foo=bar'
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200
Response JSON 'form' field equals {'foo': 'bar'}
Response JSON 'json' field is null
Response JSON 'data' field is empty string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: form field reflected in response
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        data={'foo': 'bar'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['form'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['args'] == {}

test_put_with_form_data_reflects_form_field()

tests.name: test_put_response_key_set_is_exact
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put endpoint is registered
actions: Send PUT /put with a JSON body
Assert the exact set of top-level keys in the response
expected: Response JSON has exactly 8 top-level keys
Keys are exactly: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin — no more, no less
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: all required fields present and no extra fields
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_put_response_key_set_is_exact():
    r = client.put(
        '/put',
        data=json.dumps({'test': True}),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    actual_keys = set(body.keys())
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert actual_keys == required_keys
    assert len(actual_keys) == 8

test_put_response_key_set_is_exact()
